paragraphs: Rav Shimi bar Ziri, before Rav Papa — [Temurah 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.24a.12).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Temurah 24a explicitly names Rav Papa as the sage before whom Rav Shimi bar Ziri recited.
In the linked Gemara, Rav Shimi bar Ziri recites a baraita before Rav Pappa. The Hebrew has זירי, which can be romanized Ziri or Zeiri.
